title: Wrap router tree with AuthProvider to eliminate useAuth runtime error

requirements.summary: Ensure all useAuth() callers (including App router root) render within AuthProvider without changing immutable main.tsx.
acceptanceCriteria: Launching the app no longer throws the error "useAuth must be used within AuthProvider".
`RootComponent` in `frontend/src/App.tsx` can call `useAuth()` successfully because it is wrapped by `AuthProvider` at runtime.
No changes are made to `frontend/src/main.tsx` (it remains unmodified).
Authentication-gated routing behavior remains intact (unauthenticated users see the Login page; authenticated users see the AppLayout).

file_operations.description: Import and wrap the existing AuthProvider (from the selected "authorization" component’s frontend auth system) around the RouterProvider so that RootComponent and all route components are always inside the AuthProvider context at runtime. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
